headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent purchases
summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, letting its Dots AI agents shop and check out on a user's behalf, starting with a limited rollout to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers using eligible American Express, Chase, Mastercard or Visa cards. One outlet frames the feature cautiously as sharing banking information with ChatGPT.
